6x6_1_AA.name: AFV6 AA
6x6_1_AA.description: The AFV6 is a fast, lightweight multipurpose armoured vehicle. This is a short range air-defence variant, with a potent 20mm rotary cannon and an IRM-S1 launcher.

6x6_1_APC.name: AFV6 APC
6x6_1_APC.description: The AFV6 is a fast, lightweight multipurpose armoured vehicle. This is the default variant, an armoured personnel carrier. The increased seating capacity allows it to capture locations faster than other variants.

6x6_1_AT.name: AFV6 AT
6x6_1_AT.description: The AFV6 is a fast, lightweight multipurpose armoured vehicle. This is an anti-armour variant, equipped with a large, long range multiple ATGM launcher. Internal stores of extra missiles reduce seating capacity substantially.

6x6_1_IFV.name: AFV6 IFV
6x6_1_IFV.description: The AFV6 is a fast, lightweight multipurpose armoured vehicle. This variant is an infantry fighting vehicle with a 25mm cannon.

AFV8_APC.name: AFV8 APC
AFV8_APC.description: The AFV8 Armored Personnel Carrier is a fast troop transport with a roof mounted machine gun to counter low-flying aerial threats and soft ground targets

AFV8_IFV.name: AFV8 IFV
AFV8_IFV.description: This upfit for the AFV8 chassis features a 25mm cannon and anti-armor missile launcher, turning it into a fast infantry fighting vehicle.

AFV8_SAM.name: AFV8 Mobile Air Defense
AFV8_SAM.description: Featuring 8 IR missile launchers, this air defense system is capable of intercepting missiles and aircraft at a range of up to 5km

AssaultCarrier1.name: Annex Class Carrier
AssaultCarrier1.description: An amphibious assault ship which can support rotary wing and V/STOL aircraft operations. It has a well deck from which it can launch landing craft, and it can perform shore bombardment with its 76mm cannon and dual-purpose 40mm point defence guns.

AttackHelo1.name: SAH-46 Chicane
AttackHelo1.description: The SAH-46 Chicane retains a traditional attack helicopter configuation while incorporating upgrades that keep it a formidable presence on the battlefield of the late 21st Century. Cutting edge stealth technology allows the Chicane to conduct pop-up attacks from behind terrain and disappear from radar without a trace.

CAS1.name: A-19 Brawler
CAS1.description: The Brawler is a reliable and rugged platform built to carry large quantities of precision weapons. Advanced propfan engines combine endurance with respectable speed, while redundant control surfaces, isolated engines, and heavy cockpit armor provide excellent survivability. The A-19 is in its element when attacking convoys of vehicles, distributed short-range air defenses, or vessels operating in coastal waters.

COIN.name: CI-22 Cricket
COIN.description: Designed for counter insurgency operations and low-intensity battlefields, the CI-22 Cricket features robust landing gear and short takeoff and landing capability, allowing it to operate from unprepared fields. While lacking in speed and survivability, the CI-22 possesses remarkable agility and the ability to mount an array of weapon types

CRAMTrailer1.name: HLT-CRAM
CRAMTrailer1.description: This trailer is equipped with a 20mm rotary gun to provide point defence against shells, missiles, bombs, and low flying aircraft within a range of approximately 3km.

Corvette1.name: Shard Class Corvette
Corvette1.description: This compact warship is well equipped for defending coastal areas, armed with a 57mm cannon, 20mm point defense system, and battery of vertically launched RAM-45 missiles. A small landing pad at the stern allows it to serve as a mobile re-arming and refueling point for helicopters.

Darkreach.name: SFB-81 Darkreach
Darkreach.description: Featuring powerful engines, a stealthy silhouette, and 4 large internal weapon bays, the SFB-81 Darkreach is a formidable bomber capable of deploying both conventional and nuclear weapons. Its blended wing design allows the Darkreach to conduct operations in a variety of flight regimes, from low-altitude penetrating strikes to standoff strategic bombardment.

Destroyer1.name: Dynamo Class Destroyer
Destroyer1.description: This guided missile destroyer is armed with a battery of vertically launched cruise missiles and a 155mm railgun in its forward turret. Its powerful defensive armament of two MMR-S3 batteries, three R9 vertical launchers and four 30mm CIWS turrets, makes the Dynamo class a powerful warship, able to defend a fleet from any threat.

EW1.name: EW-25 Medusa
EW1.description: The EW-25 is a short take-off, vertical landing (STOVL) support aircraft with a variety of powerful electronic warfare systems. Able to triangulate radar positions, jam enemy radar installations, suppress air defences, and even shoot down missiles with a high energy laser, a single Medusa can easily turn the tide of a battle.

Emplacement1_23mm.name: 23mm AAA Emplacement
Emplacement1_23mm.description: This manually aimed static air defense position is a simple and low-cost means of defending point targets from helicopters and other low-flying aircraft. Its small size and low profile make it difficult to spot from a distance.

Emplacement1_ATGM.name: AT-145 Emplacement
Emplacement1_ATGM.description: The AT-145 is a short-range anti-tank guided missile designed for knocking out vehicles, emplacements and small buildings.

Emplacement1_MANPADS.name: IRM-S1 Emplacement
Emplacement1_MANPADS.description: The IRM-S1 is a man-portable air defense system (MANPADS) effective at countering air threats within 5km. An infrared homing seeker allows the missile to lock onto any aerial target with a heat signature.

FastBomber1.name: Alkyon AB-4
FastBomber1.description: The Alkyon AB-4 is an advanced supersonic bomber with electronic warfare capabilities, designed to stealthily deliver nuclear or conventional payloads onto high value targets. 4 afterburning engines combined with variable geometry wings provide incredible top speed and enough maneuverability to evade aerial threats. If critically damaged, a crew escape capsule allows for safe ejection at any altitude or airspeed.

Fighter1.name: FS-12 Revoker
Fighter1.description: The FS-12 Revoker is built for agility above all else, capable of extreme maneuvers at almost any speed. Internal weapon bays help reduce drag, allowing supersonic speeds even at low altitudes and with heavy payloads. While less stealthy than newer fighters, the Revoker remains a cost-effective means of establishing air superiority.

FleetCarrier1.name: Hyperion Class Carrier
FleetCarrier1.description: The Hyperion class features a short take-off ramp and arrestor gear on its landing runway, and can accommodate a variety of aircraft types. Defended by two MMR-S3 batteries, one RAM-45 launcher, and two 30mm CIWS turrets, this fleet carrier is capable of countering most aerial threats.

Frigate1.name: Argus Class Frigate
Frigate1.description: Bristling with air defense weapons, the Argus class is a missile frigate designed to protect valuable assets from air attack. Capable of locking down airspace in a wide radius, it is an essential component of BDF naval doctrine. The Argus class is fitted with the NL-98 active radar homing missile, capable of engaging datalinked targets at beyond visual ranges.

HLT-FC.name: HLT Fire Control
HLT-FC.description: Command vehicle capable of distributing targets from a radar to individual SAM launchers in a battery

HLT-FT.name: HLT Fuel Tanker
HLT-FT.description: Airbase support vehicle capable of refueling aircraft parked within 300m

HLT-L.name: HLT Flatbed
HLT-L.description: Logistics vehicle with a loading system capable of handling a variety of tasks

HLT-M.name: HLT Munitions Truck
HLT-M.description: Support vehicle capable of rearming friendly units within 300m

HLT-MART.name: HLT Mobile Artillery
HLT-MART.description: This advanced and highly mobile long-range artillery system fires 155mm laser guided shells. Capable of bombarding targets 40km away at a sustained 5 rounds per minute, the HLT Mobile Artillery will frequently relocate to avoid return fire.

HLT-R.name: HLT Radar Truck
HLT-R.description: Capable of tracking multiple aerial units at ranges of up to 100km (60m).

HLT-T.name: HLT Tractor
HLT-T.description: Heavy duty tractor cab for hauling large trailer systems

LCV45.name: LCV45 Recon Truck
LCV45.description: Though lightly armed and armored, the LCV45 is a fast vehicle ideal for forward scouting

LandingCraft1.name: OTB-31 landing craft
LandingCraft1.description: Designed for rapidly delivering vehicles from Annex class assault carriers to landing points, this fast hovercraft can carry up to 80 tons of cargo and is equipped with an IRM-S1 launcher and heavy machine gun for self defense.

LaserTrailer1.name: HLT-HEL
LaserTrailer1.description: A Laser Air Defence System capable of destroying small calibre aerial munitions.

LightTruck1_AA.name: LCV25 AA
LightTruck1_AA.description: The LCV25 is a 4x4 all terrain vehicle, offered in AA or AT configurations, combining the agility of a light recon vehicle with the firepower of heavier fighting vehicles. It is air transportable, with 2 units fitting inside the cargo bay of a VL-49 Tarantula.

LightTruck1_AT.name: LCV25 AT
LightTruck1_AT.description: The LCV25 is a 4x4 all terrain vehicle, offered in AA or AT configurations, combining the agility of a light recon vehicle with the firepower of heavier fighting vehicles. It is air transportable, with 2 units fitting inside the cargo bay of a VL-49 Tarantula.

Linebreaker_APC.name: Linebreaker APC
Linebreaker_APC.description: An armored personnel carrier upfit for the Linebreaker chassis, this troop transport is well protected with good off-road mobility

Linebreaker_IFV.name: Linebreaker IFV
Linebreaker_IFV.description: Sporting a powerful autocannon and anti-armor missiles, the Linebreaker Infantry Fighting Vehicle is a versatile unit capable of engaging both air and ground threats

Linebreaker_SAM.name: Linebreaker SAM
Linebreaker_SAM.description: This armored air defense vehicle combines off-road mobility with 12 short-range IR missiles capable of engaging low-flying aircraft

MBT.name: Type-12 MBT
MBT.description: While the Type 12 may be a legacy design, it still remains a formidable presence on the battlefield. It offers better protection per unit weight than its contemporaries, owing to its novel monocoque composite hull & turret that give the Type-12 its signature shape. Its armament consists of a 130mm cannon firing hypervelocity SABOT rounds and a turreted 12.7mm machine gun.

MBT1.name: Spearhead MBT
MBT1.description: With a liberal application of armour and weapon modules, the latest iterations of the Spearhead are as protected as they are powerful. The combination of 130mm main gun and ATGM launcher allow it to hold its own against larger numbers of enemy armoured units, while the roof mounted 20kw pulse laser can protect the relatively thinner top armour against missiles. Its ever-growing list of capabilities has come with a diminished top speed and a total weight far exceeding its original design specifications.

Multirole1.name: KR-67 Ifrit
Multirole1.description: A large, carrier capable, twin engine multirole fighter, the Ifrit is equally suited to air superiority and ground attack missions. It features excellent thrust and maneuverability alongside reduced radar signature and powerful sensors. Two internal weapon bays plus two additional side bays for heat-seeking missiles allow the Ifrit to carry a significant internal payload without impacting stealth or top speed.

PatrolBoat1.name: Surf Class Patrol Boat
PatrolBoat1.description: The Surf Class is an inshore patrol vessel, nominally used for border protection and anti-piracy duties. While it lacks the staying power of larger ships, its speed and complement of vertically launched AGM-48s can make it a credible threat to them. The 30mm main gun has proximity fused shells and provides some amount of self-protection against missile attack.

QuadVTOL1.name: VL-49 Tarantula
QuadVTOL1.description: Combining vertical lift capability with a 20 ton cargo capacity, this large quad tiltwing can deliver crucial supplies to forward positions or serve as a versatile gunship. Its 4 proprotors are linked by internal driveshafts, allowing the Tarantula to continue flying after absorbing significant damage.

RadarSAM1.name: T9K41 Boltstrike
RadarSAM1.description: This formidable anti-air unit incorporates a radar capable of tracking multiple aerial targets at a range of up to 15km, and carries 16 vertical-launch missiles which can be fired in rapid succession

SAMTrailer1.name: StratoLance R9 Launcher
SAMTrailer1.description: Long range air defense trailer capable of engaging aerial targets detected by nearby radar trucks

SPAAG1.name: AeroSentry SPAAG
SPAAG1.description: This self-propelled anti-aircraft gun sports twin 30mm autocannons firing proximity-fused shells, capable of accurately striking fast-moving targets at ranges of over 4000m

SPAAG2.name: FGA-57 Anvil
SPAAG2.description: Firing 57mm proximity fused explosive shells, the Anvil is capable of dealing devastating volleys against both air and land targets

SmallCarrier1.name: Cursor Class LFD
SmallCarrier1.description: The Cursor class represents the vanguard of the BDF fleet. This littoral flight deck (LFD) is designed to rapidly deploy light VTOL aircraft from shallow waterways. It employs a small waterplane area twin hull for stability and speed, and mounts a variety of short-range defensive weapons including a laser air defense system.

SmallFighter1.name: FS-20 Vortex
SmallFighter1.description: A compact and advanced multirole fighter, the Vortex is capable of operating vertically from small carriers and remaining undetected thanks to outstanding stealth characteristics. While fast, agile, and stealthy when lightly loaded, these characteristics can suffer when carrying a heavy payload of weapons.

Truck2-CRAM.name: MSV CRAM
Truck2-CRAM.description: A Modular Support Vehicle equipped with a 20mm rotary gun to provide point defence against shells, missiles, bombs, and low flying aircraft within a range of approximately 3km.

Truck2-FC.name: MSV Fire Control
Truck2-FC.description: Command vehicle capable of distributing targets from a radar to individual SAM launchers in a battery

Truck2-FT.name: MSV Fuel Tanker
Truck2-FT.description: Airbase support vehicle capable of refueling aircraft parked within 300m

Truck2-L.name: MSV Flatbed
Truck2-L.description: Logistics vehicle with a loading system capable of handling a variety of tasks

Truck2-LADS.name: MSV LADS
Truck2-LADS.description: Modular Support Vehicle carrying a Laser Air Defence System capable of destroying small calibre aerial munitions.

Truck2-M.name: MSV Munitions
Truck2-M.description: Support vehicle capable of rearming friendly units within 300m

Truck2-MLRS.name: MSV MLRS
Truck2-MLRS.description: 18-tube Multiple Launch Rocket System installed on an MSV chassis, providing mobile rocket artillery.

Truck2-MRAP.name: MSV MRAP
Truck2-MRAP.description: A lightly armed and armored personnel carrier built on the Modular Support Vehicle chassis

Truck2-R.name: MSV Radar
Truck2-R.description: Capable of tracking multiple aerial units at ranges of up to 100km (60m).

Truck2-RSAM.name: MSV R9 Stratolance Launcher
Truck2-RSAM.description: Long range air defense unit capable of engaging aerial targets detected by nearby radar trucks

Truck2-T.name: MSV Tractor
Truck2-T.description: Tractor unit for hauling trailer systems

UGV1_SAM.name: Hexhound SAM
UGV1_SAM.description: A Hexhound equipped with a four-shot IRM-S1 launcher. Its small profile makes it hard to detect, allowing it to ambush low flying air targets.

UGV1_grenade.name: Hexhound GMG
UGV1_grenade.description: A Hexhound equipped with an automatic grenade launcher. The grenade launcher is able to rain indirect fire on datalink targets within 2km.

UGVDozer1.name: M12 Jackknife
UGVDozer1.description: A small, remote-controlled, air-transportable combat engineering unit designed for light role forces. Combat engineering units are able to facilitate the repair and reconstruction of destroyed hangars, helipads and vehicle depots.

UtilityHelo1.name: UH-90 Ibis
UtilityHelo1.description: Designed for a PALA fast vertical lift program in the 2050s, the UH-90 was conceptualized as a medium-sized compound utility helicopter, but has since been fitted with numerous weapon stations allowing it to occupy a gunship role. Featuring a coaxial rigid rotor system and two reversible turbine-electric ducted fans in pusher configuration, the Ibis can rapidly reach high cruising speeds before decelerating to a vertical landing in less than 30 seconds.

VehicleDepot1.name: Vehicle Depot
VehicleDepot1.description: Vehicle deployment facility. Can defend itself with small arms fire.

ammoDump.name: Ammo Dump
ammoDump.description: An open stockpile for storing conventional ammunition. Can resupply units within 300m.

ammunitionBunker.name: Munitions Bunker
ammunitionBunker.description: Reinforced bunker for storing ammunition and nuclear warheads. Can resupply units within 300m. It is resistant to bombs and missiles, often requiring multiple direct hits or large/penetrating munitions to destroy it.

enrichmentPlant1.name: Enrichment Plant
enrichmentPlant1.description: Supplies fissile material for nuclear weapons. Having an enrichment plant ensures a steady supply of nuclear warheads.

factory_large.name: Large Factory
factory_large.description: A vehicle manufacturing facility, housing a production line and its associated machinery. Factory buildings supply a specific type of vehicle to a faction's inventory.

factory_tall.name: Vertical Factory
factory_tall.description: A low-footprint vehicle manufacturing facility, housing an entirely automated production chain. Lighting, heating, and floorspace requirements are only considered for the handful of quality assurance workers overseeing the facility. Factory buildings supply a specific type of vehicle to a faction's inventory.

fuelTank1.name: Fuel Depot
fuelTank1.description: Aviation fuel depot that can fill empty aircraft tanks within 300m.

gabionBunker1.name: Infantry Bunker
gabionBunker1.description: A concealed front line fighting position of an infantry team armed with light machine guns, grenades, and rocket launchers. Capable of ambushing unsuspecting vehicles that enter its field of fire.

guardTower1.name: Guard Tower
guardTower1.description: An elevated, air conditioned chair for a human sentry. Reveals targets within a 5km radius, and will defend itself with small arms fire within a 1km radius.

pillbox.name: Pillbox
pillbox.description: Designed to supplement and eventually replace human sentries, the pillbox represents part of a networked perimeter monitoring system. The hardened structure houses a pair of autonomous 12.7mm machine gun turrets.

refinery_main.name: Refinery Structure
refinery_main.description: Synthetic fuel production unit capable of converting a large variety of organic feedstocks into fertilizer and combustible fuels.

revetment1.name: Aircraft Revetment
revetment1.description: Protected parking area for aircraft, shielded from shrapnel

shelter1.name: Hardened Aircraft Shelter
shelter1.description: A reinforced hangar which stores fighter aircraft and a small complement of nuclear warheads. It is resistant to bombs and missiles, often requiring multiple direct hits or large/penetrating munitions to destroy it.

storageTank.name: Storage Tank
storageTank.description: Refrigerated, in-ground bulk liquid gas storage. Thick concrete for insulation makes it difficult to damage with weapons fire.

trainer.name: T/A-30 Compass
trainer.description: An advanced jet trainer which is well suited for light combat duty, the T/A-30 is highly maneuverable at low to medium speeds and possesses forgiving flight characteristics. Particularly adept at low-altitude strike missions, the Compass features redundant control surfaces and twin engines to improve survivability.
